title: Panchatv Bharat IPO Details
intro:
Panchatv Bharat IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹24.58 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 17.56 lakh shares of ₹24.58 crore.

Panchatv Bharat IPO opens for subscription on Sep 10, 2026 and closes on Sep 15, 2026. The allotment for the Panchatv Bharat IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 16, 2026. Panchatv Bharat IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 18, 2026.

Panchatv Bharat IPO is set final issue price at ₹140 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,80,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,20,000.

Mark Corporate Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Panchatv Bharat IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2024, Panchatv Bharat is a textile manufacturing company. The company manufactures denim fabrics through third-party facilities and also wholesales denim fabrics across India, sourcing them from distributors for nationwide distribution.
Their manufacturing process encompasses the entire fabric production cycle—from yarn procurement and warp dyeing to weaving, finishing, and quality inspection.
The company engages in third-party manufacturing and wholesale trading of denim fabrics for men’s and women’s wear, supplying mainly to Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, and other key Indian states.
The company sold to 35 distributors as of June 30, 2024, and over 80 in FY 2023–24, with most revenue coming from Delhi and sales across multiple Indian states.
As on June 30, 2025, the company has 13 employees including Managing Director, Whole-Time Director, Key Managerial Personnel, Middle level and support staff.

faqs.question: How to apply in Panchatv Bharat IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Panchatv Bharat IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Panchatv Bharat IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Panchatv Bharat IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Panchatv Bharat IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Panchatv Bharat IPO?
faqs.answer: Panchatv Bharat IPO lot size is 1000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,80,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Panchatv Bharat IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Panchatv Bharat IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Panchatv Bharat IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Panchatv Bharat IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Sep 17, 2026 . Check the Panchatv Bharat IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Panchatv Bharat IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Panchatv Bharat IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Sep 18, 2026 .
